problem_statement: The LwM2M client library provides lwm2m_set_cache_filter() so applications can register a callback that filters cached time-series samples before they are stored. When the resource data cache support is disabled (CONFIG_LWM2M_RESOURCE_DATA_CACHE_SUPPORT not set), calling lwm2m_set_cache_filter() must return -ENOTSUP, and the function must also accept a NULL callback to clear a previously registered filter.

verification.reason: The statement gives the function name and disabled-cache return value but omits the call's parameter shape, which a C test needs to compile; this can be repaired by stating the public parameters without revealing implementation.

problems.detail: The hidden test calls lwm2m_set_cache_filter(&path, NULL), but the statement does not state that the function takes an object path pointer and a callback pointer; it only names the function and the -ENOTSUP/NULL behavior.

problem_statement_fixed: The LwM2M client library provides lwm2m_set_cache_filter() so applications can register a callback that filters cached time-series samples before they are stored. The function takes the object path of the cached resource (a const struct lwm2m_obj_path *) and a filter callback pointer; passing NULL clears any previously registered filter. When the resource data cache support is disabled (CONFIG_LWM2M_RESOURCE_DATA_CACHE_SUPPORT not set), calling lwm2m_set_cache_filter() must return -ENOTSUP, including when the callback argument is NULL.
